source: 氧化苦参碱与抗肿瘤药物相互作用对HNE-1、HNE-1(200)细胞周期的影响_王驰.pdf
text: 相互作用结果相似, 并且对两细胞株作用无显著差别。结论 Oxy 联合抗肿瘤药物后, 可使鼻咽癌耐药细胞株和非耐药细胞株均产生 G₁ 期阻滞, 抑制细胞增殖, 其作用与经典化疗增敏剂 VRP 相似, 这为将 Oxy 作为化疗增敏剂提供了依据。文献标志码：A Influence of joint action of oxymatrine and antitumor drugs on cell cycle of HNE-1 cell line and HNE-1 (200) subline WANG Chi $^{1}$ , CHEN Hong-yan $^{2\triangle}$ , YE Lin $^{2}$ , et al.Abstract: Objective To investigate the influence of joint action of natural active ingredient oxymatrine (Oxy) and common antitumor drugs (vincristine, bleomycin, cisplatin and 5-Fu) on cell cycle of HNE-1 cell line and HNE-1 (200) subline. Methods HNE-1 cell line and multidrug resistant HNE-1(200) subline were chosen to carry out the experiment, and both cell lines were divided into control group, Oxy group (combined administration of antitumor drugs and Oxy) and verapamil group (combined administration of antitumor drugs and verapamil). Flow cytometry was applied to detecting the change of cell cycle. Results The interaction of antitumor drugs and Oxy resulted in experimental strain blockage in $\mathrm{G_0 / G_1}$ phase. So did the interaction of antitumor drugs and verapamil. No significant difference in the change of cell cycle were found between the two cell lines after the combination therapy, and also no significant differences were found between the effects of oxymatrine and verapamil after the combination therapy. Conclusion Oxymatrine administration combined with antitumor drugs can induce nasopharyngeal carcinoma resistant and non-resistant strain blockage in $\mathrm{G_0 / G_1}$ phase, and give rise to the suppression of inhibition of cell proliferation. Its effects were similar to those of classical sensitizer verapamil, which provides the laboratroy evidence for the use of oxymatrine as an adjunct to chemical therapy.化疗是临床上肿瘤治疗的三大途径之一，将抗肿瘤药物作用于肿瘤细胞，将导致细胞周期发生变化，细胞增殖受到抑制，最终诱发细胞凋亡从而杀伤肿瘤细胞。
